image_description: A low-angle shot of a street sign assembly against a deep blue sky. The assembly includes a dark, arched top bar with fragmented white lettering and red accents, a central dark rectangular panel, and a lower, weathered white rectangular sign with large, distorted black characters. The signs are mounted on a vertical pole structure.
